code='''def transform(grid):
    # Extract the alternating background and stripe pattern.
    rows = [0] + [r for r in range(len(grid)) if len(set(grid[r])) > 1 and len(set(grid[r])) > 1 and sum(v != grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]) > 1] + [0]
    # Stripe rows are uniform except at vertical-line crossings.
    h = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        vals = [v for v in row if v != 0]
        if vals and len(set(vals)) == 1 and len(set(row)) > 1:
            h.append((r, vals[0]))
    # Detect horizontal stripes by their dominant nonzero color.
    h=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        counts={}
        for v in row:
            if v: counts[v]=counts.get(v,0)+1
        if counts and max(counts.values()) >= len(row)-2:
            h.append((r, max(counts,key=counts.get)))
    v=[]

        col=[grid[r][c] for r in range(len(grid))]
